comment: Nested property edits (a key inside a property's map, up to two levels) shared by src/lib/frontmatter-nested.ts and src-tauri/src/index/patch/nested.rs. frontmatter is the YAML between the --- fences (no trailing newline); path is [property, key] or [property, key, key]; op is set (the key exists), add (it does not; appended at the end of its map), remove or rename-key (to is the new name). expected is the whole frontmatter afterwards, or null when the edit must be refused. Both test suites read this file; the TS panel splicer and the Rust patcher must produce these exact bytes.

  # about flags

    old: false
license: MIT
cases.expected:
